title: Heat Pumps Don’t Work In Winter??? (Sub Zero Temps)
summary: A UK owner shows his heat pump keeping the house at 20.7°C at -3 to -5°C with 40°C radiators and no extra insulation, while conceding heat pumps are expensive and not financially viable for many.
